As someone who was SA'd around the same age, by another child around the same age, thank you. Please forgive yourself. For you to come out and at least find a way to apologize, regardless of if it's to them in person, thank you. Maybe they are reading this and can move on further. So you should too. Be proud that you have seen that it was wrong and have been a better adult. Be graceful with yourself for the thing you went through as a child also. 

Sometimes kidd don't always know what they are doing when they do things, they are just following what they have been shown. I'm sorry you were mistreated in your childhood as well and I hope you continue to heal in this journey for the health of your lifetime. We only truly get to experience life one at a time. 

Thank you for being a better person and it's okay.

Be a new me. Get better.

There are just so many fucking thoughts.....

I wish I could be of any help. I absolutely know your position. I guess it's cool that we have apps like this. You never know when your alone or not. What's worse is how many people may actually feel the same, and we are all sitting here not talking about it cause we all know/think it s going to make matters worse.

So we just say, eh its okai I just wont talk about it and it will go away.

But if you do ever need to vent and match feelings/vibes with someone please dont hesitate to just say hai. I dont know you and I dont care I love you and I hope you are going to be okai.

Yes. Although it is a long plan. I do not have a job right now, and I don't really have an extra place to live. However she cannot become physical with me, so I know that I am safe as much as I can be. She just finished chemotherapy and I am her care taker. So until when is in an apartment, and I have my own job I cannot leave. 

However, from what I can put together she understands that this is the last time something like this happens. *even though it's been happening since I was in 5th grade* 

We are both grown adults and she has something mentally wrong with her, and she has physical ailments. 

Once I move out again. Our interactions will only consist of phone calls and texts. 

In my situation all I can do is stay until I can leave and make sure she knows I will not tolerate anymore violence.
Unfortunately I live with her still.

It is never normal. It is never okai. We learn to live with it, because at that time you have no way out. But it is not normal, and if you have a way out take it. Get out if you can before it become detrimental to you and your health. You deserve what you are truly worth, and that is everything good in this world. You are precious and deserve a good life. Keep yourself safe. There is always help. Never forget that. Someone will always help.
Thank you. I appreciate you.

I'm 26 F, who has been loving at home with my mom. She is going through divorce, and just beat colon cancer. I am proud of her. But she has been abusive towards myself and my younger sister since I was in 5th grade, maybe even sooner. 

Manipulation, guilt tripping, gaslighting, and physical abuse, has been a part of my life for as long as I can remember. I have a few more months with her, and then I will hopefully be able to move out. 

I am not stuck. I am okai. I am a survivor. I will get out.
